LESSON: SARUFI 13.4.1 UKANUSHAJI KWA KUZINGATIA HALI MAZOEA

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.4: Sarufi 13.4.1 Ukanushaji kwa Kuzingatia Hali mazoea

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 13.4.1 Ukanushaji kwa Kuzingatia Hali mazoea. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya ukanushaji ili kuupambanua
2. kutambua ukanushaji kwa kuzingatia hali ya mazoea na timilifu katika matini
3. kukanusha sentensi kwa kuzingatia hali ya mazoea na timilifu

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya ukanushaji ili kuupambanua
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya ukanushaji ili kuupambanua. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua ukanushaji kwa kuzingatia hali ya mazoea na timilifu katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua ukanushaji kwa kuzingatia hali ya mazoea na timilifu katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kukanusha sentensi kwa kuzingatia hali ya mazoea na timilifu
   In simple words: practise until you can kukanusha sentensi kwa kuzingatia hali ya mazoea na timilifu. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 13.4.1 Ukanushaji kwa Kuzingatia Hali mazoea using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 13.4.1 Ukanushaji kwa Kuzingatia Hali mazoea in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 13.4.1 Ukanushaji kwa Kuzingatia Hali mazoea to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 13.4.1 Ukanushaji kwa Kuzingatia Hali mazoea.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya ukanushaji ili kuupambanua

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 13.4.1 Ukanushaji kwa Kuzingatia Hali mazoea using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 13.4.1 Ukanushaji kwa Kuzingatia Hali mazoea important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya ukanushaji ili kuupambanua
2. kutambua ukanushaji kwa kuzingatia hali ya mazoea na timilifu katika matini
3. kukanusha sentensi kwa kuzingatia hali ya mazoea na timilifu

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
